description: Search for companies by industry, keywords, size, location, technology or domain. Consumes Apollo credits (~1 credit per page); the call is checked against the per-call credit budget first. Requires at least one filter. Paginated with an opaque `cursor`; pass it back unchanged. Use it to find accounts, then sdr_search_people with `organization_domains`, or sdr_enrich_company for details.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous call. Omit to start at page 1.

items.description: An employee range like "51,200" (use sdr_lookup_filters kind "employee_range").

name: sdr_search_companies
title: Search companies
